page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores, with 1.0 thread per core, ensuring dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for operating system and application data. It lacks hardware acceleration, containing zero GPUs, and does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses. These hardware limitations constrain its utility for data-intensive or graphics-accelerated workloads.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.s2.large offers a low-overhead, entry-level hardware profile. The dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable compute performance for lightweight applications, making it qualitatively cost-effective for workloads that do not require high memory capacity or local disk I/O. Suitable workloads include basic web serving, lightweight microservices, development environments, and simple utility tasks.
